author: misterdesigns
quote: GTA used to be a hardcore, trashy, controversial game where you could do crazy, outrageous things without everything being censored. That was part of its identity. Now it feels like the developers decided to turn it into some woke, politically correct life **** hookers, no crashing planes into buildings, no killing protesters, no crossing certain lines because apparently everything has to be sanitized. Instead of the outrageous freedom that made GTA famous, we're getting household chores, painting walls, and activities that feel more like The Sims than Grand Theft ****'s almost as if someone decided that gamers didn't want the wild, chaotic GTA experience anymore, but rather a social experiment about teaching men to do housework and serve **** whole thing feels like a game redesigned around an ideological agenda instead of what made the franchise great in the first place. GTA was supposed to be outrageous, offensive, unpredictable and unapologetically trashy. That's what made it **** I wanted to play The Sims, I'd play The Sims. I bought GTA for Grand Theft Auto, not a woke domestic simulator.
